title: A study to determine possible etiological links between biological factors and dentofacial phenotypes
summary:
The aim of the study is to investigate the relationship between individual dental characteristics and hereditary factors. Therefore, we want to answer the following questions with this study: 
1. Do biological factors such as hereditary factors play a role in the development of individual characteristics of teeth?
2. Are these factors related to tooth development or to the response to orthodontic treatment?
We would like to use orthodontic treatment records of our patients for the study.  These documents (e.g. questionnaires, x-rays, photos, impressions) are/were prepared for the orthodontic treatment. No additional documents will be collected for the study. Saliva will also be collected for the investigation of hereditary factors and various proteins.

interventions.name:
Children, adolescents and adults undergoing orthodontic treatment at the Polyclinic for Orthodontics at Bonn University Hospital or in participating practices and who have given informed consent to participate in the study.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
The informed patient and, in the case of minors, their legal guardians must have consented to participate in the study. The diagnostic documents which are relevant for the individual examinations (outcomes) must be available and have been prepared as part of a medically indicated dental-orthodontic diagnosis and treatment. An exception is the saliva sample to be obtained as part of the study. In addition, only systemically healthy patients or patients with mild systemic and well-controlled diseases should be included in the study.
Exclusion criteria:
Patients with serious systemic diseases and known genetic and non-genetic syndromes as well as traumas or operations in the head and neck area
